metadata.description: Hi5 Success OS: A suite of Claude plugins for YouTube growth, business planning, content repurposing, and marketing execution.

plugins.name: content-os
plugins.description: A content system in five skills: plan, research, script, edit, caption, upload, and blog. The Content Manager, Video Editor, Social Media Manager, YouTube Manager, and Blog Writer each run from one Notion Content Calendar, done by Claude, a person, or nobody. Every skill also works on its own.

plugins.name: business-os
plugins.description: Business planning, goal setting, performance review, voice creation, dashboard, team org chart, and bottleneck finding tools, plus a Coach Library of the posts you learn from and a personal advisory board that weighs your decisions, for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

plugins.name: marketing-os
plugins.description: Email, newsletter, SEO, LinkedIn, website copy, landing pages, and case study tools for consistent marketing execution.

plugins.name: real-estate-os
plugins.description: Real estate only skills for agents, teams, and brokers: CRM by conversation, listings, sellers, buyers, transactions, daily planning, sphere, prospecting, ads, role-play, rentals, investors, commercial, land, and area fact files, with Fair Housing, texting consent, and approval-first guardrails.

plugins.name: connectors-os
plugins.description: Local connectors for Hi5 members, set up by conversation with one command. Edit videos in CapCut with Claude through the CapCut bridge, and schedule GoHighLevel social posts with media from your computer. Checks what is installed and offers updates. Windows, Claude desktop app.
